I replied to Ilse in our DM: her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is now Bay 30. I didn't take any other action.

I didn't save this to my long-term memory, because that memory gets loaded into every conversation, including other members' chats. Saving it there could leak something Ilse told me privately. The note stays in my DM with her, so I can look it up there when she asks.
